desc:
Pull your bike out of the garage and ride Miami with your crew. Find the balance point, drag a fender down the block, then run it back in Cinematic Replay. 🏍️

🔧 Build your bike or quad in the Workshop with custom wraps, wheels, and lights. Make your own tricks and see what other riders are selling on the Market.

🖥️ PC — Hold E to mount. F starts the engine. W/S for gas and brake, A/D to steer, E/Q to shift up/down, Left Ctrl for clutch, Z/X/C for trick slots, and G to get off.

🎮 Controller — Hold Y/△ to mount. D-pad Left starts the engine. RT/R2 is gas, LT/L2 is brake, and the left stick steers and leans. LB/L1 shifts up, RB/R1 shifts down, and clicking the right stick dismounts.

📱 Mobile — Hold the Ride Bike prompt and tap Engine. Use the Steer/Lean stick, Gas, brakes, +/− gears, and numbered trick buttons. Tap Get Off to dismount.

🛑 Stoppies — On a dirt bike, build some speed. Hold Shift + S on PC. On controller or mobile, lean forward and hold the front brake.
